items.title: Explore training options
items.contentHtml:
This approved static publisher-feed record explains how readers can compare training paths and prepare questions for an official education or employment service. It contains no vacancy or live job-board record.

Plan the next step

Readers can review programme descriptions, entry requirements and official contacts before continuing. This guidance does not promise admission, funding, employment or an individual outcome.

The bounded complete record supports offline section extraction and exact-hash review without using WorkBC's currently blocked public crawl route.
